        print('song_library_page_empty', page_index)
        break
    if len(resp)==0:
        print('song_library_page_len0', page_index)
        break

        sid = s['song_id']
        title = s['title']
        artists_pipe = '|'.join([a['name'] for a in s.get('artists', [])])
        if sid not in song_dict:
            song_dict[sid] = (title, artists_pipe)
        else:
            # verify consistency
            if song_dict[sid] != (title, artists_pipe):
                print('conflict_song', sid, song_dict[sid], (title, artists_pipe))
    page_index += 1
    if page_index % 5 == 0:
        print('song_library_pages_done', page_index, 'unique', len(song_dict))

print('song_library_unique_songs', len(song_dict))

import os, re, math, json

# --- Login tokens ---
pw_map = {x['account_name']: x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()

spotify_token = apis.spotify.login(username=profile['email'], password=pw_map['spotify'])['access_token']
file_token = apis.file_system.login(username=profile['email'], password=pw_map['file_system'])['access_token']

# --- Helpers ---
def csv_escape(val):
    s = '' if val is None else str(val)
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',', '\n', '\r', '"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

# Use dict keyed by song_id to ensure uniqueness across sources
songs_by_id = {}  # song_id -> {'Title':..., 'Artists':...}

PAGE_LIMIT = 20

# 1) Song library
page_index = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=PAGE_LIMIT, sort_by=None)
    if not resp:
        break
    for s in resp:
        sid = s['song_id']
        title = s.get('title','')
        artists_pipe = '|'.join([a.get('name','') for a in s.get('artists', [])])
        songs_by_id.setdefault(sid, {'Title': title, 'Artists': artists_pipe})
    page_index += 1
print('after_song_library_unique', len(songs_by_id))

# 2) Album library -> fetch album details to get song title/artists
page_index = 0
album_ids = []
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=spotify_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=PAGE_LIMIT, sort_by=None)
    if not resp:
        break
    for a in resp:
        album_ids.append(a['album_id'])
    page_index += 1
print('album_library_albums_found', len(album_ids))

# dedupe album ids
album_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(album_ids))

for i, album_id in enumerate(album_ids):
    alb = apis.spotify.show_album(album_id=album_id, access_token=None)  # access_token optional
    for song in alb.get('songs', []):
        sid = song['id']
        title = song.get('title','')
        artists_pipe = '|'.join([a.get('name','') for a in song.get('artists', [])])
        songs_by_id.setdefault(sid, {'Title': title, 'Artists': artists_pipe})
    if (i+1) % 10 == 0:
        print('processed_albums', i+1, 'unique_songs_so_far', len(songs_by_id))
print('after_album_library_unique', len(songs_by_id))

# 3) Playlists in playlist library (both public and private) -> fetch playlist details to get songs
playlist_ids = []
for is_public in [True, False]:
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, query='', is_public=is_public, page_index=page_index, page_limit=PAGE_LIMIT, sort_by=None)
        if not resp:
            break
        for p in resp:
            playlist_ids.append(p['playlist_id'])
        page_index += 1
print('playlist_library_playlist_ids_found', len(playlist_ids))
playlist_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(playlist_ids))

for i, playlist_id in enumerate(playlist_ids):
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_token)
    for song in pl.get('songs', []):
        sid = song['id']
        title = song.get('title','')
        artists_pipe = '|'.join([a.get('name','') for a in song.get('artists', [])])
        songs_by_id.setdefault(sid, {'Title': title, 'Artists': artists_pipe})
    if (i+1) % 10 == 0:
        print('processed_playlists', i+1, 'unique_songs_so_far', len(songs_by_id))
print('after_playlists_unique', len(songs_by_id))

# --- Create CSV content ---
# sort deterministically
items = list(songs_by_id.items())
items.sort(key=lambda kv: (kv[1]['Title'].lower(), kv[1]['Artists'].lower()))

header = ['Title', 'Artists']
lines = [','.join(header)]
for sid, info in items:
    title = info['Title']
    artists = info['Artists']
    lines.append(csv_escape(title) + ',' + csv_escape(artists))
content = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'

print('csv_rows', len(items))
print('csv_header', lines[0])
print('csv_first3', lines[1:4])

# --- Write to file_system ---
dir_path = '~/backups'
file_path = '~/backups/spotify_library.csv'

# Create directory if missing
if not apis.file_system.directory_exists(directory_path=dir_path, access_token=file_token)['exists']:
    apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=dir_path, access_token=file_token, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True)

res = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=file_token, content=content, overwrite=True)
print('file_write_result', res)
